summary: 44-year-old woman and her 11-year-old daughter went for a nature walk from camp near Bellaire Campground on Manhattan Road and did not return by dark; a SARDOC dog team fielded at 11 p.m. and located the pair by voice at 1:15 a.m. after a thunderstorm; both were in good shape despite light jackets and sandals.
notes: Date Saturday-verified (search night 8/15-16). One other SARDOC team plus two non-SARDOC dog teams also responded.
